name: @nikcli-ai/remote
description: NikCLI remote terminal server - Mobile access via WebSocket with QR code

scripts.build:server: bunx tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --target es2022 --out-dir dist --splitting false --platform node --external ws --external ghostty-web --external qrcode --external localtunnel
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.compile: bun run build && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --outfile=dist/nikcli-remote --target=node
